protocol.source: Week 3 Phase 3 holdout user IDs and target movie IDs
protocol.week2Method: Existing binary-genre three-movie profile and rankMovies; most recent three ratings >=4 strictly before held-out timestamp
protocol.week3Methods: Existing raw co-rated-only User-Based and Item-Based functions; no overlap weighting
protocol.activeUserTrainingHistory: Only timestamp < held-out timestamp; remove held-out and all same/later active-user ratings from matrix during both CF calls
protocol.candidatePool: All catalog movies except active-user movies rated strictly before holdout, for all three methods
protocol.crossUserHistory: Other users retain their full ratings, as in Phase 3; this is not a global chronological split
protocol.ordering: Profile events: timestamp descending then movie ID ascending; Week 2 near ties preserve source order; Week 3 exact score ties use movie ID
protocol.metric: Exact movie ID HitRate@5 and MRR@5 on common aligned cohort; Top-5 overlap by movie ID
protocol.profileMinimum: 3 earlier positive movies; also require 20 earlier ratings to preserve Phase 3 remaining-history minimum
protocol.scoresNotComparable: Week 2 genre cosine and Week 3 predicted ratings have different meanings and scales
